title: The Republic
author: Plato
engineRationale: Plato's foundational masterwork is allegorical and psychological: the Cave, the Ring of Gyges, the Tripartite Soul, and the descent through 5 political regimes are abstract conceptual metaphors with archetypal roles rather than documentary footage. Flat-vector rigged characters, geometric motifs, and kinetic typography (Antidote) deliver the highest visual clarity and retention.
